**About The Role

**Our engineers work alongside AI agents every day, writing code, reviewing changes and shipping. As our Developer Productivity Engineer, you will make that work as fast and as good as it can be.

This is a modern take on developer experience and DevOps. You will own the design of our codebase and refactor it so agents and people can navigate and change it safely, keep the documentation in our code current and useful, and bring agents into CI/CD and code review. Your users are our engineers, and you measure your success by how fast and how well they ship. You will be based in our Copenhagen office.

What you'll do

• Find where engineers lose time, and fix the biggest problems first

• Structure our codebase so agents and people can navigate, understand and change it safely

• Write and maintain the agent instructions, skills and rules that encode how we work

• Generate high-quality documentation in the code, automatically where possible, and keep it current

• Bring agents into CI/CD, from agentic code review and test generation to fixing failing builds

• Keep builds, tests and deploys fast and reliable

• Work closely with our AI engineers, and share what you learn about evals, techniques and the latest in agentic coding

What we're looking for

• 5 or more years of experience in software engineering, with time on a developer platform, developer experience or build and CI team

• Daily, hands-on use of AI coding agents, and clear views on what makes them work well

• Experience building CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling that many engineers rely on

• Comfort working across a large monorepo

• You treat internal tools as products and your colleagues as their users

• You measure where engineers lose time, and show that your fix gave it back

Nice to have

• Experience at a company that grew its engineering team quickly

• Experience with monorepo build tooling

• Experience building agents, or tools for agents

**Job Description

**

Manager, Strategy & Execution

Posting Start Date: 10/26/26

Alcântara, PRT, 1300‑001, | Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

**Manager, Strategy & Execution

**

• Location: Copenhagen / Lisbon

• Work model: Hybrid / Full time

• Contract type / duration: Permanent

Do you want to lead projects that influence the future direction of global business? Are you curious about how to keep a strategy alive across a global organization? Are you excited by working closely with experienced leaders to solve the most challenging problems in our business? Then you might be who we are looking for!

You will be part of our Strategy & Execution team and work on high-impact, cross-functional projects that help drive STG's strategy forward. You will work directly with the Head of Strategy and the rest of the team, partnering closely with business leaders and subject matter experts across the organization. You can expect to spend your time both supporting the Executive Board decision-making, and working with the business to drive execution. Your contributions will drive strategic initiatives, bring new clarity to complex problems, align stakeholders through challenging trade-offs and ultimately help STG deliver our strategic ambitions. Our team are the stewards of the Focus2030 strategy, and you will play a core part in keeping the strategy alive in the business while remaining responsive to market changes and execution learnings.

This would be an ideal role for an associate-manager level consultant looking to transition into a corporate role so they can take longer term ownership of their projects and see them come to life.

**What Your Day Will Look Like

**As a Manager in the Strategy & Execution team, you can expect to work across a wide range of projects and initiatives. Example projects could include:

• Preparing materials for the Board of Directors strategy days

• Developing a methodology to define future market roles

• Building a business case to optimise our product portfolio to maximise growth and operational efficiency

• Supporting a business team to prioritise their focus areas for the strategy period

• Reviewing our progress to delivering our strategy for the Exec Board

• Creating a new Exec Board KPI dashboard to continuously monitor the success of strategy execution

• Developing a comms plan for Focus2030

**Role

**Your role will vary from developing content yourself to collaborating closely with others, depending on the project or business needs. Your role will often include:

• Project managing complex, cross-functional projects

• Creating insightful analysis (gathering, testing, combining, summarising, visualising)

• Developing frameworks to bring simplicity and clarity to complex problems and decisions

• Working closely with experts and stakeholders to identify and refine recommendations

• Running workshops with senior leaders

• Building slide decks to tell a compelling message

• Managing and supporting the development of more junior team member(s)

What You’ll Bring

• 
You will bring a minimum of 3-4 years of strategy and/or management consulting experience

• 
Experience in a corporate environment (permanent or secondments) is a plus

• 
Problem and decision structuring – experience building frameworks to simplify challenges and decisions to enable the business to move forward

• 
Experience in Consumer-Packaged Goods and/or Retail sectors

• 
Demonstrated project management experience and attention to detail

• 
Strong stakeholder management and team working experience

• 
Demonstrated strong analytical skills including experience delivering complex analyses in Excel

• 
Understanding P&L / key accounting principles / Cashflow modelling is a plus

• 
Understanding of data structuring principles and leveraging multiple data sources a plus

• 
Good slide development skills (storyboarding, content development, polishing) for C-level messaging

• 
A learning and growth mindset – developing yourself and supporting the development of the team around you

• 
Experience and curiosity in using GenAi tools to accelerate and improve your work, including effective prompting, iterative refinement and critical evaluation of AI outputs

• 
Professionally fluent in English

What You’ll Learn

• 
There will be a strong investment in your development where you need it, with a variety of experiences and supportive coaching

• 
This could include:

• 
Deepening your experience in the CPG / Retail sector

• 
Refining your presentation skills, to communicate complex topics in a clear and effective way

• 
Leading projects that are critical to our strategy success

• 
Strengthening your stakeholder management skills in a complex, cross-functional, international organization

• 
This role will give exposure to senior leaders across business globally and equip you to be a transformation leader with extensive experience working alongside C-suite

• 
Our Strategy department, which brings together teams focused on strategy execution, consumer insights, business intelligence, data, and sustainability, will provide you with an opportunity to broaden your expertise across these disciplines too

**Working At STG & What To Expect

**At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next. At STG you'll find more than a role—you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact. Our Strategy team brings together over 15 nationalities and 20 languages, for a culturally rich and diverse environment.

We work flexibly and understand the importance of balancing work with your personal life. At the same time, collaboration is a key part of how we work, so you can expect to be in our office in Gentofte or Alcantra at least 3 days per week.

**Our recruitment process

****Requirements

If your experience and skills are a good match, you'll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which will likely follow the following steps:

• Recruiter Screen

• Team Interview

Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply now and discover **so much more.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Are you a fire protection and security systems specialist looking to develop robust technical solutions within one of Denmark’s largest electrical engineering teams in Buildings and Industry? Do you thrive on thoughtful building design, reliable systems and multidisciplinary collaboration across a diverse project portfolio? If so, we would like to hear from you.

**

**Create the solutions that enable a better tomorrow

**We are seeking a Senior Security and Fire Specialist to strengthen our expertise in security and fire protection systems for complex projects that support essential societal functions. You will join COWI’s Buildings and Industry division, where approximately 500 specialists work with clients on some of the most significant projects in Denmark and internationally.

You will be part of an international network of specialists, collaborating closely with colleagues across disciplines and countries. With a primary focus on fire protection and security systems, you will play a key technical role in both your own assignments and larger multidisciplinary projects. Sustainability and digital development are priorities at COWI, and an interest in integrating these perspectives into your work would be an advantage.

We welcome candidates from a range of professional backgrounds. As a large electrical engineering discipline within Buildings and Industry, we bring together diverse skills and experience, united by a commitment to collaboration, integrity and a positive working environment. You may have a qualification in electrical installation, electrical engineering, marine and technical engineering, or a related field.

**Your key responsibilities will be:

**

• Working with fire protection and security systems, including ABA, ABDL, AVA, ABV, ADK, AIA and TVO

• Preparing project documentation throughout all phases of major construction projects

• Providing technical consultancy, design, specifications and tender documentation for security and fire protection systems

• Undertaking project follow-up, site supervision and commissioning of security and fire protection systems

• Developing and sharing best practice, exchanging knowledge and maintaining up-to-date technical expertise within the discipline

**Your skills. Our team. Together, we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

**You will also bring

**

• In-depth knowledge of security and fire protection systems, gained through practical experience, formal education or a combination of both; your specific educational background is not a determining factor

• The ability to communicate clearly, precisely and unambiguously in both written and spoken English and Danish

• Recent, relevant experience with security and fire protection systems

• Ideally, more than 10 years of experience providing consultancy on security and fire protection systems

• Knowledge of CER and NIS2 would be an advantage

• The ability to obtain security clearance to at least HEM (SECRET) level

**A place to work – and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Do you have more questions?

**For more information about the position and what we offer, please contact Priyanka, our Global Talent Acquisition Specialist, at prki@cowi.com.

Learn more about our projects, strategy, ambitions and life at COWI at www.cowi.com.

We are committed to a fair and unbiased recruitment process. To support this, please do not include a photograph in your CV.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, and inclusion is integral to the way we work.

**We are committed to a respectful and equitable workplace where every colleague feels a sense of belonging and has equal opportunities to thrive and develop. We expect our leaders to model inclusive leadership and foster a culture that values different perspectives and ideas. Diversity and inclusion inform our relevant decisions and processes, as well as the way we bring teams and forums together. This reflects our values and our belief that it is the right thing to do.

In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to a portfolio of corporate clients across different industries and levels of complexity, helping them navigate their risk and insurance needs in the context of their strategy, operating environment and future ambitions.

You will be responsible for deepening existing relationships, identifying opportunities to create additional value, and bringing Marsh’s full range of capabilities into play where relevant. With a strong foundation in general insurance, you will combine client insight, commercial drive and structured execution to help clients make better decisions and unlock new opportunities.

This is a highly client-facing and commercially focused role. You will work closely with clients to understand their business, priorities and risk profile, and translate that understanding into tailored Marsh solutions that support both resilience and growth.

You will join a Corporate team in Aarhus with a clear ambition to grow and further strengthen how we serve corporate clients across Jutland. We are building a team that combines strong local client relationships with specialist expertise, data and the global capabilities of Marsh. You will have the opportunity to play an active role in that development.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Build trusted client relationships by understanding their strategy, business model, operating environment and risk exposure.

**

• Strong understanding of general insurance and risk transfer solutions.

• Commercial mindset with the ability to identify opportunities, develop relationships and drive growth.

• Ability to understand client businesses and connect market developments, strategy and risk.

• Ability to think beyond insurance and identify where broader expertise and advisory capabilities can create value for the client.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, both internally and externally.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex issues clearly and confidently.

• Experience contributing to and coordinating renewal and placement strategies, with the ability to lead the overall client dialogue.

• High professional integrity, ownership and a client-centric approach.

• Fluency in English and Danish, both spoken and written.

**What Makes You Stand Out

**

• Demonstrated success in developing new business within the corporate segment.

• Ability to think beyond insurance and connect client needs to broader advisory opportunities.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data and insights to shape client discussions and decisions.

**What We Offer

**

• The opportunity to work with a diverse portfolio of corporate clients across multiple industries.

• A commercially meaningful role with both client ownership and growth responsibility.

• The chance to work in a collaborative environment with experienced colleagues and access to Marsh’s global expertise.

A lead role, reporting to the founder and CEO, for someone who wants to own how a multi-product platform is explained, launched and sold to hundreds of thousands of experience businesses, from a product marketing perspective - and who wants to grow faster than a normal career path allows. For someone who gets both product and marketing on a very intuitive level.

This is not the average job post. And Understory is not the average company.

Laura is a kind, creative, positive soul who loves to cook and loves teaching others to cook. So she started a company offering cooking classes for locals and tourists. The venue is authentic and beautiful - her taste is unique and welcoming. The classes are thoughtfully designed. Every detail is considered. And the bookings start to tick in. It works. Laura gets to do what she loves, creating strong memories for people from all over the world.

But she is also starting to struggle. Managing participants. Hiring and training instructors. Chasing invoices. And the quiet pressure underneath it all: making sure more bookings arrive tomorrow than today.

That passion, and that struggle, is what Understory is built on. We help experience hosts turn their passion into profits by taking care of operations and growth, so that our customers can focus on their craft and passion - and their guests.

Here is the thing about Laura: she does not wake up thinking about software. She has never heard of Understory, and she has a hundred reasons not to change anything. Someone has to make her see, in her own words and in under a minute, that there is a better way to run and grow her business. This role will play an instrumental part in creating that epiphany.

Who is Understory?

Understory is an AI-powered, vertical-focused, multi-product operating system for experience businesses. With it, creators like Laura manage operations, accept payments, build beautiful websites, and automatically grow bookings across channels. Even the bookkeeping runs itself.

There are hundreds of thousands of Lauras across Europe. Nobody has built and served the platform they deserve, yet. We intend to.

We have the product, 1,000+ operators across the Nordics, Italy and Spain, customers in 10+ countries, and a recently raised €12m Series A to be the driving force in a fragmented market. We have been ranked no. 2 in Notion Capital's Cloud Challengers Top 100 and recently won the EY Entrepreneur Of The Year 2026. We are ~ 80 people across Aarhus, Copenhagen and Barcelona, and we are just getting started.

Over the next 12 months we are re-launching how Understory shows up in the market: from a booking system to the growth partner for experience businesses, with a substantially improved product line-up and from that, a refreshed positioning.

The team

The role sits in Product and reports directly to the CEO, Lasse - the role will work in the important intersection between product and GTM.

The Understory product-team is absolutely firing and launching amazing, unique value every single week. This has created the very positive problem, of us not getting all that value explained and communicated into the market. This is the problem we are looking to solve, with this role.

Product marketing does not exist as a dedicated function at Understory today. Pieces of it are done by founders, product managers and marketers on the side - but the baseline is low and the potential is massive. You will be the first person to own it full-time, which means you get to help define it as well.

**About The Role

**You own how the market understands our products and releases - and the system and processes that make it happen at scale. You build on top of the company positioning, set by the founders, and a really powerful and successful product. You own the positioning and messaging for each product - Booking, Pay (and POS), Marketing, Reviews, Accounting, and the ones coming next - and the customer cases that prove it.

This is a hands-on role. You will talk to operators every week, study competitors closely, own the product messaging yourself, pick the cases worth telling, and tell them well. You will also be in the room when product decisions get made, because the person who hears every week how the market understands us should have a say in what we build.

What you will do

• Own the positioning and messaging for each product, built on top of the company positioning: who it is for, what it does better, and how it is different from the booking systems, marketplaces and agencies operators compare us to

• Stress-test the company positioning against what you hear from operators and see from competitors, and challenge us when it does not hold

• Know the competitive landscape better than anyone in the company, and keep everyone current on where we win and where we do not

• Craft the stories that carry the positioning: the company narrative, the story for each product, and the customer cases that prove it

• Find and tell those cases: the operators whose results show what Understory does, told so the next Laura sees herself in them

• Turn positioning into launches: plan and run product launches end to end, from customer interviews to live on the website, in the backoffice and with Sales

• Equip Sales and Customer Success with the story: pitch, one-pagers, battlecards, stories etc. - all grounded in the positioning

• Feed customer and market insight back into Product

• Lead the market-facing side of the 2027 Spring Launch with all that entails

We think you will thrive if…

• You are obsessed with how products are understood and promoted: the gap between what a product does, what competitors claim, and what the market understands. You cannot leave it alone

• You have real product marketing or go-to-market experience you can show us: a positioning you wrote, a customer story you told, a launch you ran, a piece of enablement that moved a number. We care about depth and quality, not years

• You are still early in your career and want to take big steps in a short time. You see a first-of-its-kind role at a Series A company as the fastest way to do that

• You set your own targets and hit them without much help. You would rather ask forgiveness than permission

• You like talking to customers and do it without being asked

• You deeply understand AI-capabilities and how you can create immense leverage in your work by using them

• You are low ego, high agency

It is a plus if you have…

• Experience with selling to small(er) businesses

• Worked with pricing and packaging

• Danish, Spanish or Italian on top of fluent English

If you meet most, but not all, of these, we still want to hear from you. How you think and how you work with people matters more than ticking every box.

What it is like to work at Understory

We are product-minded, mission-driven and serious about quality. We think long term, we evolve constantly, and we give people room to grow into roles that did not exist when they joined. You get to help shape a category-defining product for people who deserve one.

Practical information

• Hours: Full-time

• Duration: Ongoing employment

• Location: Aarhus, Copenhagen or Barcelona, in-office

• Team: Product

• Reports to: Lasse, CEO

• Comp structure: Salary + Warrants

• Preferred start date: As soon as possible, flexible

How to apply

Click "Apply for this job". Skip the classic cover letter. Instead, send us:

• A few lines on why you are learning and moving faster than most other product marketing talents

• One thing you have made that you are proud of - a launch, a positioning doc, a landing page, a sales deck - and three lines on why it worked.

Working at the intersection of Talent, technology, data, and AI, you'll define product strategy, influence senior stakeholders, and deliver solutions that create exceptional employee experiences and measurable business value.

WHAT MAKES US, US

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

Portfolio Analysis is where investment professionals turn data into insight on portfolios, performance and risk. Our products are business critical and widely used, so they need to keep evolving in a responsible way. Right now that means strong maintainability, high system performance, mature CI/CD, and reshaping parts of SimCorp Dimension for the cloud.

As a Senior Software Engineer in our Product Division, you will join an agile team of 5–7 people in the Portfolio Analysis Product Area. You will mainly work on backend components, APIs and services, using C#, .NET, Dyalog APL and Oracle.

AI is part of how we work every day. We see it as a natural part of modern software engineering, alongside source control, testing, CI/CD and code reviews. AI does not replace engineering judgment. It helps good engineers learn faster, reduce repetitive work and build better software.

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

• Understand and challenge customer requirements together with your team, then design, implement, test and support the chosen solutions

• Design, develop and maintain backend functionality and APIs using C# and .NET, and work with Dyalog APL where it is part of the product

• Contribute to cloud modernization and scalable service design where it adds real value

• Improve performance, maintainability, testability and developer experience

• Take ownership beyond code: contribute to design discussions and help the team make sound technical decisions

• Use CI/CD, automated testing and code reviews as natural parts of daily engineering work

• Use AI every day in practical engineering work, such as exploring ideas, understanding unfamiliar code, prototyping, improving tests, documenting decisions and automating routine tasks

• Help the team discover where AI creates real value and where traditional engineering judgment should lead

• Collaborate with product owners, domain experts and fellow engineers to turn customer needs into good software

WHAT WE VALUE

How you gained your skills matters less than your ability to learn, collaborate and take ownership. We expect you to know some of the following and to be interested in learning the rest:

• C# and .NET development, backend development and API design

• Building high-performance, scalable and maintainable applications

• Continuous integration and delivery, automated testing and practical quality engineering

• Relational databases, preferably Oracle or similar

• Cloud technologies, distributed systems or Azure-based services

• Willingness to learn additional technologies, including Dyalog APL

• Curiosity about AI-assisted software engineering and daily use of modern tools

• Experience with financial instruments or investment systems is an advantage but not a requirement. We will bring you up to speed through training and a comprehensive onboarding program.

We also value people who take ownership and deliver results. We look for engineers who try new approaches, work with others to leverage everyone’s strengths, and balance technical quality with business value. We want you to help build an inclusive, trust-based engineering culture.

BENEFITS

• Global hybrid work policy – We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. You can work remotely the other days if you choose.

• Growth and innovation – Every sixth sprint is reserved for planning, innovation, learning and improvements.

• Self-direction – Teams and developers have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.

• Modern engineering in a real product context – You will work on cloud modernization, AI-enabled development and performance in large-scale financial software.

• Inclusive and diverse company culture – We want people to bring different perspectives and contribute to a respectful workplace.

• Work-life balance – We believe balance between professional and private life makes us better colleagues and better engineers.

• Empowerment – All voices are valuable, and you will be involved in shaping our work processes.

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually**. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on a positive growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are focused on continually improving our talent acquisition process and making everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

WHO WE ARE

We are 3,000 colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experience, and backgrounds. SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of Deutsche Börse Group. For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and skills are integrated into our everyday work.

Our client is a successful international distributor of specialty chemicals, with operations across a number of international markets and a presence in more than 20 countries.

As Regional Director – Nordics & Baltics, you will have overall responsibility for the business unit's development, performance, and future direction in the region.

Your primary task will be to set the strategic direction and ensure the continuous development of the business. You will play a central role in translating the group's ambitions into concrete goals and results, as well as creating the organizational and commercial framework for future growth.

• Translate the group's overall ambitions into concrete strategies, goals, and action plans.

About You

You have leadership experience and a strong strategic understanding. You possess the ability to gain commitment, set direction, and develop an organization through clear leadership, involvement, and trust.

At Struers, we help companies and laboratories around the world understand their materials and make confident decisions about quality. Our purpose is Ensuring Certainty, and behind the equipment that delivers that certainty is increasingly sophisticated software.

• Test and verify software directly on real machines and equipment.

• Contribute to code reviews and analysis of other developers’ work.
